incidents.name: Aperture Finance arbitrary call approval drain
incidents.notes: The closed-source Aperture router forwarded caller-supplied call targets and calldata without validation, letting the attacker make the contract invoke ERC-20 transferFrom() and ERC-721 transfers against the standing token and Uniswap V3 position approvals users had granted it.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim created 2025-12-15 by 0xbeef63ae5a2102506e8a352a5bb32aa8b30b3112 (not the attacker), no EIP-1967 Upgraded event before the incident. The anchored tx is the attacker's contract-creation tx; its logs show 36.918 WBTC pulled from user 0x5240b03be5bc101a0082074666dd89ad883e1f9d to the attacker EOA plus a Uniswap V3 position mint. Reported incident total $3.67M across Ethereum/Arbitrum/Base.
